description: Head-movement mini-game GA04: slow up/down stretch-hold exercise. Voice-guided, segmented motion only — look up to a mild stretch, hold 5 seconds, return to center, look down, hold 5 seconds, return, 3 up + 3 down = 6 reps. A one-prompt start calibration (look down once) learns which pitch sign means down; up is the opposite sign. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: stretch-hold
